sectors.trend: Iron ore shakeout underway amid geopolitical distraction; gold and small-cap miners (Kaoko, Vanadium Resources, Piche, Aurum, Brightstar, Solstice, Power Minerals) outperforming on relative value
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face margin pressure from demand softness; gold miners (GOLD.AX, NVG.AX) and lithium/vanadium names offer diversification. War-driven supply disruption may provide temporary price support

sectors.trend: CBA flags 15% drop in home loan applications; banks forecast record house price falls; CBA/Westpac facing scrutiny over loyalty pricing loopholes; ASIC whistleblower review at Big Four adds governance overhang
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, WBC.AX, ANZ.AX face NIM compression and credit cycle risk; rate sensitivity elevated. Defensive dividend yield remains attractive but earnings trajectory is deteriorating

sectors.trend: EV sales surpassed petrol cars in Australia; BYD declares tipping point reached; hidden costs (grid, charging) emerging; VW cutting 50,000 jobs globally signals auto sector distress
sectors.implications: WES.AX, AGL.AX, CGP.AX benefit from electrification demand; oil & gas (WDS.AX, WLE.AX) face structural demand risk. Charging infrastructure and grid upgrade plays gain relevance

sectors.trend: Bathla collapse signals sector-wide fragility; Worksafe re-examining Star; $550m Melbourne freeway and 'biggest shortcut' negotiations provide offsetting demand
sectors.implications: WTC.AX, WBC.AX (construction exposure) face quality-of-earnings risk; government infrastructure spend supports short-term order books but margin compression likely

sectors.trend: Ozempic maker (Novo Nordisk) in trouble, shifting to tablets; Lululemon cuts forecast; consumer spending under pressure from fuel costs and housing stress
sectors.implications: CSL.AX, SGH.AX remain defensive anchors; consumer discretionary (WOW.AX, LPX.AX) face headwinds. GLP-1 tablet transition may disrupt supply chains

sectors.trend: Cheap drones disrupting defence procurement; AI worker shortage driving skilled migration policy; Zeta surging on AI marketing; Duolingo turned bullish
sectors.implications: ASX-listed defence (DPL.AX, WES.AX) and tech (W1.AX, XRO.AX) benefit from policy tailwinds; AI theme remains a global risk-on driver

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA rate path / hawkish global data
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce duration in rate-sensitive sectors (REITs, property); favour fixed-income ladders; monitor RBA statement for September
Underweight banks on credit loss provisions; monitor NIM trends; consider CBA.AX/WBC.AX only on deep value

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Iron ore demand shock / China slowdown
risk_assessment.mitigation: Diversify away from pure iron ore (RIO.AX, FMG.AX); favour gold and lithium exposure
Avoid small-cap construction; favour government-backed infrastructure contracts
Monitor Victorian bond spreads; reduce exposure to state-linked REITs

risk_assessment.risk_factor: El Nino / cyclone risk to energy & insurance
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge energy infrastructure exposure; monitor insurance loss ratios

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight gold and small-cap miners as relative-value and inflation hedge
opportunities.rationale: Gold stocks trading without chasing; Aurum adding high-grade ounces; Kaoko, Vanadium Resources, Piche showing momentum; iron ore shakeout supports rotation into precious metals

opportunities.recommendation: Position for EV transition beneficiaries in energy and infrastructure
opportunities.rationale: EV sales surpassed petrol cars; BYD confirms tipping point; grid upgrade and charging demand structural; WES/AGL/CGP benefit from electrification capex

opportunities.recommendation: Selective bank exposure on deep value / dividend yield
opportunities.rationale: Banks forecast record house price falls but remain cheap on P/E; CBA 15% loan drop is a leading indicator but dividend yield compensates; ASIC review adds governance premium

opportunities.recommendation: Defence and AI-adjacent small caps on policy tailwinds
opportunities.rationale: Cheap drones upending defence procurement; AI worker shortage driving migration policy; Zeta and Duolingo show global AI theme resilience

defensive_moves.rationale: Record house price falls forecast; loan applications down 15%; housing construction to follow prices lower; rate sensitivity elevated

defensive_moves.recommendation: Underweight pure iron ore / thermal coal names
defensive_moves.rationale: Structural shakeout underway; war masking demand weakness; China EV transition reducing long-term coal/ore demand

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge construction and consumer discretionary risk
defensive_moves.rationale: Bathla collapse signals sector fragility; consumer spending pressured by fuel costs and housing stress; Lululemon cut forecast globally

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain under pressure in 1-3 month window. Hawkish US data and RBA higher-for-longer stance cap cyclicals. Housing credit deterioration (15% loan drop) will feed through to bank earnings. Gold and defensives (CSL.AX, WES.AX) outperform. Expect volatility around RBA September decision.
market_outlook.long_term: 6-12 month outlook cautiously constructive on rotation: EV transition, defence spend, and AI infrastructure provide structural growth pockets. However, Australia's stalling per-capita growth vs Canada and construction sector fragility cap upside. Iron ore shakeout may create entry points for quality miners. Housing correction likely 10-15% peak-to-trough.
